purpose: Cheap falsification of the historical SEC confidential-treatment order source route before any candidate performance work.
row_contract: filing date must be a valid ISO date inside the fixed window
CIK must be numeric and normalized to 10 digits
archive filename must begin with edgar/data/

deterministic_header_sample.rule: For each calendar year, inspect the first, median and last recovered CT ORDER accession in filing-date/accession lexical order; fewer than three rows yields all available rows.
deterministic_header_sample.purpose: Route and archive integrity only; the sample is not an issuer-selection or outcome-selection device.

header_contract: CONFORMED SUBMISSION TYPE must be CT ORDER
ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME must be explicitly present and parseable in the SEC public filing representations; permitted sources are filing header, filing detail page, or complete submission header
accession number must match the filename-derived accession

filed-as-of-date must match the form-index filing date when present; legacy representations may omit the field, in which case the form-index filing date is retained as the authoritative filing-date value
linked_archive_contract: complete submission text URL is derivable from filer CIK and accession
index-header document list must expose a CT ORDER document
primary CT ORDER document must be retrievable from the exact SEC archive path
cheap_falsifiers: one or more fixed quarterly SEC index transports cannot be retrieved through any official equivalent transport
CT ORDER rows cannot be deterministically parsed
the permitted SEC public filing representations lack acceptance time or contradict index metadata
complete submission text or CT ORDER document is not recoverable for sampled rows
event density is too sparse to support a meaningful later structural census
archive identity depends on hindsight or a third-party source
